data.one_liner: A lightweight DI container for Dart with singleton and named factory support.
data.what_it_does: klizma provides a minimalistic dependency injection container that lets you register factories and singletons, then resolve them by type or name. It has no external dependencies and works on all Dart platforms.
use_when: You need a simple, zero‑dependency DI solution for a small to medium project.
You want named factories to differentiate between multiple implementations of the same type.
You prefer a straightforward API without code generation or annotations.
avoid_when: You require advanced features like scoped lifetimes, automatic injection via annotations, or integration with Flutter widgets.
You need a full‑featured service locator with lifecycle management like get_it.
weaknesses: No built‑in support for scoped or transient instances

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Widely used, feature‑rich service locator with support for scopes, factories, and integration with Flutter.

alternatives.name: injector
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar lightweight DI container with optional code generation.

alternatives.name: watch_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a reactive DI container with change notification.
